mentions.name: Spellfolio
mentions.description: A web-based multiplayer stock trading game inspired by board games, for 1-8 players. Players act as amateur psychics navigating a fictional stock market, receiving premonitions, calling in a wizard friend, and navigating dividends and earnings releases. It features a tutorial and bots, and emphasizes economy, bluffing, forward-planning, risk-taking, and course-correcting mechanics, culminating in annual investor awards.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a multiplayer stock trading game that was inspired by all my favorite board games. https://www.spellfolio.com/

It's a web-based game for 1-8 players, features a tutorial and bots, plays like a board game, and operates with economy, bluffing, forward-planning, risk-taking, course-correcting mechanics.
